extracted.intended_audience: creative writers, students, and critics of contemporary/literary fiction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and evaluative criteria for composing or assessing maximalist novels (long, formally ambitious works in the tradition of Wallace, Pynchon, Bolaño, etc.). Emphasizes large scale, formal experimentation, and moral/affective stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition — maximalist novel
rubrics_metrics.description: "A long novel with a layered structure that exploits sophisticated literary devices."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the overall genre definition: long form + layered architecture + formal/sophisticated devices. Examples given: Infinite Jest, Gravity's Rainbow, 2666, The Recognitions, Ulysses, Underworld.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encyclopedic knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporates vast, diverse knowledge (media theory, linguistics, science, sport, economics, theology, etc.), often footnoted, glossed, and digressive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must demonstrate genuine command of incorporated domains rather than superficial or 'Wikipedia-skimming.' Digressions should feel informed and purposeful, not merely showy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earned length
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantial length (usually 800+ pages) that is justified by complexity rather than gratuitous expansion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Length is a quality criterion only when every additional page contributes necessary complexity, architecture, or depth; anti-pattern is bloat that lacks justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple interweaving storylines
rubrics_metrics.description: Interlocking plots, characters, settings, and time periods that create a layered narrative structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Storylines should interrelate in ways that reward the reader's attention; isolated or incoherent threads that never cohere count against the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylistic range
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of multiple voices, registers, and prose modes within a single book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinct registers should be recognizable and purposeful; variety should feel controlled rather than arbitrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Deployment of experimental forms such as footnotes, fragments, lists, found documents, and embedded forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovative forms should serve the book's aims (narrative, thematic, or epistemic) rather than functioning as mere gimmickry. Examples include extensive endnotes or nested paratexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural critique
rubrics_metrics.description: Satirizes or interrogates contemporary excess (capitalism, media, technology) while often enacting similar excesses formally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective maximalist critique both demonstrates awareness of the systems it satirizes and uses the novel's form to embody or illuminate those systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moral earnestness beneath irony
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'white-hot purity of moral purpose' or moral seriousness that underlies formal play and irony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The tension between irony and sincerity should produce ethical or affective stakes; works that are formally brilliant but emotionally hollow fail this test.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justified complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Every layer, digression, and formal device must earn its place in the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complexity for the sake of complexity is an anti-pattern; judges/readers should be able to see why each element exists and how it contributes to the whole.

rubrics_metrics.name: Architectural coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Apparent chaos is organized according to an underlying architecture; the book's scale is held together structurally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even extreme digression and multiplicity should reveal organizing principles. Lack of coherence or an inability to map relationships among elements is a shortcoming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice mastery
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple voices are distinct yet integrated into a single work; the author maintains control across registers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinctiveness of voice should not devolve into fragmentation; the author must demonstrate technical control and intentionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genuine domain expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrable, authentic knowledge of the specialized subjects the novel includes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surface-level or lazy borrowing of domain details undermines credibility. Scholarship or deep familiarity strengthens maximalist claims and supports encyclopedic ambition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affective engagement ('Heart')
rubrics_metrics.description: Readers must care about characters, themes, or stakes even amid difficulty and density.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emotional engagement is a core requirement: technical virtuosity should not preclude readerly investment. Works that alienate readers emotionally risk failure despite formal achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate evaluation to aims
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete rubric must judge a work by what it sets out to do, recognizing that maximalist and minimalist aims differ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid applying concision-focused rubrics to maximalist work or complexity-focused rubrics to minimalist work; assess fit-to-ambition and success at stated goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of paratext (endnotes/footnotes) as technique
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive or nested endnotes/footnotes and other paratextual elements used as integral parts of structure and meaning (e.g., 388 endnotes in Infinite Jest).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paratext should enhance architecture, provide worldbuilding, or create formal resonance; if paratext is merely decorative or unreadable, it weakens the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invented terminology and world-specific vocabulary
rubrics_metrics.description: Coined vocabulary and unusual terms that contribute to worldbuilding and thematic concerns (e.g., 'Subsidized Time', 'the Entertainment').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Neologisms should clarify or deepen the reader's understanding of the fictional world rather than confuse or alienate; they should feel necessary to the book's logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentence-level virtuosity amid structural complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical excellence at the sentence and paragraph level coexisting with large-scale structural ambition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long, virtuosic sentences and micro-level craftsmanship should support, not overshadow, the work's broader architecture and emotional aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension between irony and sincerity
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal irony should be balanced by genuine moral or emotional seriousness; this productive tension is a craft marker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Too much irony without seriousness produces cynicism; too much earnestness without formal self-awareness can feel naive. Skilled maximalist work navigates the balance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-take psychological description
rubrics_metrics.description: Extended, sustained psychological scenes or character interiority (long-take descriptions) that probe characters in depth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These passages should justify their length by yielding insight into character or theme; meandering interiority without payoff is a risk.
